reuse.numeric: Reuse existing passing V4; no new mode0/1/2 qualification population
reuse.profiling: Reuse eight accepted raw Torch profiles and exact launch counts from f10b6eaa; no duplicate five-call profiler or NCU in latency actions
reuse.original_harness: Preserve old protocol/window and c8a snapshot; new narrow versioned M2048-only latency phase must be separately source-bound and CPU-qualified before executable requests can be sealed

population.freshness: A fresh contained process/independent conditioning and fresh CUDA-event instances for each block; physical-device history remains recorded, not asserted independent
population.scheduling: Six tiny logical block actions submitted through existing PB campaign interface only after source/instrument qualification and exact rootGO. PB owns serialization/placement; sameSparky exclusive dependency, no second scheduler.

conditioning.workload: Unscored alternating legacy/PM full forwards on same prepared resident arms and M2048 inputs; synchronize and attribute each arm sample; no scoring during reference selection
conditioning.reference_rule: Before the first scored block, freeze the median of valid qualified SM-frequency samples from both arms during the final30s qualifying alternating-arm window. Persist target with immutable reference identity. Every block and scored cell uses that same target; never retarget after scored effects. If no valid first reference forms within180s, fail the design.
conditioning.authority: No clock/NTP/driver/power actuation without a separately qualified and authorized owner. If existing device policy cannot meet plateau predicates, stop rather than asserting DVFS removed.

scored_controls.throttle_state: Same reason bitmask; no newly asserted thermal throttle
scored_controls.cadence: Require established true sensor-update cadence, valid sample identity/native timestamps and covering observations around each scored interval. Preserve host monotonic+wall read bounds separately. Do not interpolate, treat polling as native cadence or count repeated response points as independent samples.
scored_controls.time_domains: CUDA events and same-host monotonic intervals are the primary latency domains. Native/reported SM-frequency provenance must be explicit; reported-clock matching does not certify effective-cycle frequency without instrument proof. Cross-host clock/energy remain HOLD underPB1440.
scored_controls.failure: Any plateau/cadence/coverage/throttle/clock-match/thermal-match/source/input/output/native/FD/resource failure invalidates the control. Preserve all failed data; no automatic retry, result-based extension, post-hoc row exclusion, threshold retuning or fallback to uncontrolled claims.

cadence_and_lag_acceptance.target: Qualification must cover subsecond scored cells, historically about0.4-0.6s, not merely30s conditioning or before/after readings.
cadence_and_lag_acceptance.predeclared_sampling_resolution_rule: Maximum qualified native update interval plus maximum sample-delivery lag must be <=one tenth of the shortest scored cell duration; at least ten genuine native timestamped observations per scored cell, with native history bracketing both boundaries. If instrument cannot provide this coverage/lag proof, fail readiness instead of interpolating.
cadence_and_lag_acceptance.interpretation: This supports sampled reported-SM matching only. It does not certify effective-cycle frequency or exclude every between-sample frequency transient; such claims need independently qualified stronger instrument/actuator evidence.

statistical_analysis.cell_statistic: Conventional median of30 raw CUDA-event observations per cell, preserving event order
statistical_analysis.block_contrast: legacy_mean=arithmetic mean of the two legacy cell medians; pm_mean=same forPM; reduction_percent=100*(legacy_mean-pm_mean)/legacy_mean; throughput_ratio=legacy_mean/pm_mean
statistical_analysis.pair_contrast: Report ABBA and BAAB block contrasts individually, pair mean and ABBA-minus-BAAB order interaction; descriptive mean/range/sampleSD of three pair contrasts
statistical_analysis.replication_unit: Independent conditioned block/pair, not720 pooled events; do not bootstrap individual events as independent runs
statistical_analysis.acceptance_scope: Three balanced pairs are minimum descriptive variance/order control, not guaranteed95% significance. No inferential/stable/general/served/energy/default promotion. Stronger inferential block count and analysis require predeclared approval before any sampling.

host_evidence.method: Existing Netdata/box-power owners, raw selected action/block/cell intervals, source-native cadence and accepted/rejected group boundaries. Preserve wall/monotonic discontinuity evidence; coarse cross-host data remains diagnostic, not interpolated energy coverage.
host_evidence.clock_owner_status: /mnt/shared/fleet-clock-diagnosis-20261002/postboot-20261003-status.json: gateway-only192.168.1.1/reference481E2358, trusted independent alignment unqualified; same-host latency remains distinct.
